q: Ddala Jonathan Edwards yali mwana wa magezi ag'ekitalo?
a: Yali mwana eyakula mu birowoozo mangu ddala, ng'ayingira Yale College mu 1716 nga tannaweza myaka kkumi n'esatu, n'amaliriza mu 1720 ng'omuyizi asinga obulungi eyayogera ku mukolo gw'okusiibula, era n'asigalayo ng'asoma eby'obwakatonda mu ddaala erya waggulu. Olugero olumanyiddwa lumulaga ng'awandiika ekiwandiiko ekirungi ennyo ku nnabbubi ezibuuka ng'aweza emyaka kkumi n'omu, naye abayivu ab'ekiseera kino bateeka ebyo bye yasooka okulaba mu nkomerero y'obuvubuka bwe, ate ebbaluwa eyalongoosebwa eyitibwa "Spider Letter" mu 1723, bwe yali aweza emyaka abiri. Ekifaananyi ekisinga obutuufu kye ky'omuvubuka agalamidde mu muddo gwa New England, ng'agoberera obuwuzi obulaamulaamu obw'ennabbubi ezisitulwa empewo, n'azuula mu zo obukakafu obw'okugaba kw'Omutonzi.

q: Edwards yawandiika ki ku muwala gwe yandiwasizza?
a: Mu 1723, ku lupapula olwereere olw'ekitabo ky'ennukuta z'Oluyonaani, Edwards ow'emyaka abiri yannyonnyola Sarah Pierpont ow'emyaka kkumi n'esatu, muwala w'omuweereza w'ekkanisa ey'e New Haven, ng'omuwala "ayagalibwa Oyo Omukulu eyakola era afuga ensi." Yawandiika nti yatambulanga ng'ayimba n'obuwoomu, ng'ajjudde essanyu nga tewali amanyi nsonga yaalyo, era ng'ayagala okutambula yekka mu nnimiro ng'alinga alina omuntu atalabika bulijjo ali naye. Kisomeka nga si bbaluwa ya kwagala wabula kitundu kya by'obwakatonda: yali azudde omuntu eyabeeranga dda mu bituufu bye yali yaakawoomerwa. Baafumbiriganwa nga 28 July 1727 era ne bazaala abaana kkumi n'omu.

q: Okuzuukuka Okukulu kwatandika kutya mu buweereza bwe?
a: Edwards yasikira entebe y'okubuulira ey'e Northampton okuva ku jjajjaawe ow'amaanyi Solomon Stoddard, era ku nkomerero ya 1734 yabuulira olukalala lw'okubuulira ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza kwokka. Mu biseera by'obutiti ne mu by'ekyeya ebyaddirira, ekibuga kyakwatibwa okuzuukuka okw'amaanyi; Edwards yabalirira nti abantu abasukka mu bikumi bisatu baakyusibwa mu kitundu ky'omwaka, mu kibuga ekyalimu abantu ng'olukumi mu kikumi. Yakinnyonnyola n'obwegendereza, ng'ateekamu ebyokulabirako by'abantu ssekinnoomu, mu A Faithful Narrative of the Surprising Work of God, ekyakubibwa emirundi mingi era ne kimufuula atiikirivu mu nsi yonna ng'omuwandiisi w'ebyafaayo by'okuzuukuka.

q: Edwards ajjukirwa mu bwenkanya olw'okubuulira "Sinners in the Hands of an Angry God"?
a: Ekifaananyi ky'omubuulizi awuluguma ku kibiina ekitiisiddwa kwe kukyusa amazima ennyo. Edwards yabuulira okubuulira okwo mu Enfield nga 8 July 1741, ng'asoma mu kiwandiiko n'eddoboozi eritayimuka era eritaliimu nneewulira; omujulizi eyaliwo Stephen Williams yawandiika nti waaliwo okusinda n'okukaaba — "Nkole ki ndyoke ndokolebwe?" — ne kiba nti Edwards yalina okulekera awo okubuulira. Amaanyi gaali mu kyawandiikibwa so si mu ngeri gye yayogeramu, era entikko ey'okubuulira okwo mu butuufu si kifaananyi kya nnabbubi wabula oluggi olwaggulwa olw'okusaasirwa olwaweebwa abaali bamuwuliriza. Mu mutima gwe yali musumba mukkakkamu, so si mubuulizi wa ntiisa yokka.

Oluvannyuma lw'okulaba okuzuukuka n'ebifaananako nabyo eby'obulimba, Edwards yawandiika Religious Affections (1746), okuwakana kwe okukuze nti eddiini ey'amazima, mu kitundu kinene, esangibwa mu kwagala okutukuvu — so si mu nneewulira embisi, so si mu kukkiriza okw'obunnyogovu, wabula mu mutima ogukyusiddwa mu butuufu ne gudda eri Katonda. Mu myaka gye egy'oku nsalo yakola Freedom of the Will (1754), ekitwalibwa nga ky'ekisinga obulungi mu mulimu gwe, era n'amaliriza Original Sin, ekyafulumizibwa mu 1758. Atera okutwalibwa ng'omutwe ogusinga obulungi ogw'eby'obwakatonda ekkanisa ya Amerika gwe yazaala.

q: Lwaki Edwards yagobebwa ekkuŋŋaaniro lye yennyini?
a: Stoddard yali amaze ebbanga ddene ng'akkiriza ku Mmeeza ya Mukama buli muntu ow'empisa ennungi, ka abe nga yali ayatudde okukyuka oba nedda, era Edwards n'atuuka okukkiriza nti Okulya kw'Omukama kwali kwa abo bokka abasobola okwatula okukkiriza okw'amazima. Bwe yakyogera mu lwatu mu 1749, ekibuga ne kimukyukira, empaka ez'eby'obwakatonda nga zeetabudde n'okwemulugunya okw'edda ku musaala gwe n'ennyombo endala. Nga 22 June 1750 olukiiko lw'ekkanisa lwalonda okumugoba, era ekkuŋŋaaniro ne likikakasa n'obungi obw'ekitalo, ne kikomya obusumba obw'emyaka abiri mu esatu. Yabuulira Okubuulira kw'Okusiibula okwezibiira okutaaliimu kwesaasira, n'oluvannyuma n'ayolekera obutaba na mulimu ng'alina mukyala n'abaana kkumi eka.

q: Kiki kye yakola oluvannyuma lw'okuva mu Northampton?
a: Mu 1751 yateekebwa mu Stockbridge, ekyalo ky'obuminsani ku nsalo ya Massachusetts, ng'omusumba w'ekkuŋŋaaniro ttono ery'Abangereza era ng'omuminsani eri Abamahican ab'e Housatonic era, oluvannyuma, eri Abamohawk. Yakwata ku ludda lw'Abatuuze mu nkaayana ku ttaka lyabwe ng'awakanya ekika kya Williams eky'amaanyi eky'ekitundu, ng'awandiika ebbaluwa ku bbaluwa okugenda e Boston ku lwabwe. Newankubadde yabuulira ng'ayita mu bavvuunuzi era ng'alina endowooza z'omulembe gwe, yagamba abaali bamuwuliriza mu bwerufu nti "tetuli balungi kubasinga mu ngeri yonna," era mu kyalo ekyo eky'ewala, nga kumpi talina tterekero lya bitabo, n'awandiika egimu ku mirimu gye egisinga obukulu.

q: Edwards yatuuka atya okukulembera Princeton, era yafa atya?
a: Mu 1757 College of New Jersey, oluvannyuma Princeton, yamuyita okuba pulezidenti waayo oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwa mukoddomi we Aaron Burr; Edwards yategeeza mu bbaluwa ey'obwesimbu nti tasaanira, naye n'ateeka okusalawo mu mikono gy'olukiiko lw'abaweereza, ne bamugamba agende. Yateekebwa mu buvunaanyizibwa nga 16 February 1758, era kawali bwe yali ali mu kibuga, n'agemebwa nga 23 February. Okugema kwagenda bubi, ne kujjuza omumiro gwe n'atasobola kumira, era n'anafuwa okumala omwezi ogwaddirira. Yafa nga 22 March 1758, ng'aweza emyaka amakumi ataano mu ena, ng'amaze wiiki nga ttaano zokka ku bwa pulezidenti.

Ng'amanyi nti afa, Edwards yawa muwala we Lucy obubaka okutwalira nnyina: nti "obumu obutali bwa bulijjo" obwali bumaze ebbanga ddene wakati we ne Sarah bwali bwa mwoyo era bwandisigadde emirembe gyonna. Abaali beetoolodde ekitanda bwe baatandika okukungubagira waggulu, yayogera omulundi gumu nate, ng'abagamba nti: "Mwesige Katonda, so temwetaaga kutya." Sarah, naye ng'alwadde, yawandiikira muwala waabwe nti "Katonda omutukuvu era omulungi atubisseeko ekire ekiddugavu," era n'amugoberera mu kufa mu myezi mitono.

q: Waliwo omulimu gwe gwonna ogwamuwangaala mu ngeri etaasuubirwa?
a: Mu 1747 Edwards yafulumya An Humble Attempt, okwegayirira Abakristaayo buli wamu okwegatta mu kusaba okwa bulijjo era okw'enjawulo ku lw'okuzuukuka n'olw'amawanga, era mu bulamu bwe kyalabika nga tekyatuukiriza kintu kya maanyi. Emyaka mingi oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwe, omusumba Omubaputiisiti Omungereza John Sutcliff yakwata okuyita kwakyo, era okuva mu nkuŋŋaana z'okusaba ezaavaamu mu Northamptonshire ne kuvaamu Baptist Missionary Society n'olugendo lwa William Carey okugenda mu Buyindi mu myaka gya 1790. Olukuŋŋaana lw'okusaba Edwards lwe yasaba lwatuuzibwa, era ne luddibwamu, abasajja be yali tasisinkanye.
